name: Swipewipe Cleanup
subtitle: A native camera roll cleanup app
description: Review photos by month or in a shuffled set of up to 40. Keep decisions are separate from the deletion queue, and deletions require review and confirmation.

apps.name: Swipewipe
apps.subtitle: Sort your camera roll at your pace
apps.localizedDescription: A native iOS photo cleanup app. Review by month or choose a random set of up to 40 photos. Keep and delete decisions are separate, and Photos are changed only after you review and confirm the deletion queue.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds in-app diagnostic logging for photo decisions and deletion requests.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Swipewipe organizes your photos by month so you can choose what to keep or delete.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Swipewipe removes only the photos you review and confirm for deletion.
